affected_component: Draft self-check with bounded self-repair (intake control plane)
invariant: Machine-drafted workspace controls must be proven mutually consistent by the Harness itself before human review and before any freeze: the existing candidate-generation ruler plus a verifier discrimination probe run automatically after drafting; a public failure is routed to the one control it implicates and repaired within a bound of three repairs through the fail-closed control-repair transaction; the report binds the proven bytes and readiness blocks freezing on MISSING/STALE/FAILED. Disagreement routing counts prior repairs of the same code; the judge gets two evidence-based attempts (with a provenance-safe artifact observation: paths, sizes, first text line) before the producer. Verifier repair may add recomputation but never weaken checks; Harness and environment failures never reach a model.
